_doc: AML Level-2 pre-registration. Single source of truth for the datagen freeze gate and the Level-2 claim. The gate (src/lakebench/aml/fidelity_gate.py, via scripts/aml_gate.py locally and score_financial_reference.py on the cluster) loads this file; AML-GOALS.md describes it. v3.5.0 (2026-09-25, AML-GOALS section 9 #37/#38) replaces the reference model's hyperparameters, the relative leakage cap and the calibration and evaluation seeds after D0 at v3.4.1 was voided as a harness failure; see changelog. Changing any value after a gate run (D0 included) requires a dated entry in AML-GOALS.md section 9 and a new evaluation seed. See AML-GOALS.md sections 3-5a.

unit_of_scoring.label: positive for T when the customer is the subject (typology::subject_index) of a T instance whose latest planted row by UETR timestamp falls in the month (dormant_reactivation: rows at or after the burst start only, anchor excluded); one-vs-rest over all scored (customer, month) units
unit_of_scoring.exclusions: not scored for T, and counted: months whose window holds that instance's planted rows with the subject as a party while the instance completes in another month; months where the customer is a non-subject participant of T (its planted-row months and the completion month)
unit_of_scoring.unit_exists: customer has at least one payment in A = [start(M) - lead_in_days, end(M)); months before burn_in_months are history only
unit_of_scoring.secondary: the entity-lifetime unit (features minus history_features, same label role) is reported as an ungated secondary block
unit_of_scoring.burn_in_note: 14 months (not 13) so the first scored month's history window, lead_in_days + history_days = 409 days before its start, lies inside the corpus

cv.note: StratifiedKFold when every row is its own customer, StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by customer otherwise (the monthly unit); the bootstrap resamples customers

reference_model._regularization_note: v3.5.0 (#37/#38): at prevalence 6e-5 to 5e-4 an unregularised log-loss leaf holding a few positives has a Newton step of about n_pos / (n_leaf x prevalence), tens of logits, so scores saturate at 0 and 1 and AP falls to prevalence (D0 at v3.4.1). l2_regularization adds to the leaf hessian and bounds the step. Chosen on the unregistered seed 7777 at scale 0.5 as the smallest tested value (1, 10, 100) with no saturated score and no positive scored 0 on any typology (l2 = 1 still saturated 2% of corridor_high_risk scores); calibrated probabilities kept (no class weighting); min_samples_leaf stays at the default because a large leaf floor caps leaf purity when positives are few.

shortcut_model.raw_rank: out of fold: direction chosen on the training folds, within-fold percentile ranks pooled

importance.max_threads_note: memory bound only: each thread holds a copy of a test fold; the importances do not depend on the thread count

model_outputs.note: for a possible model-training workload (#36): per-unit out-of-fold scores (unit key, typology, label, score, fold), permutation importances on each fold's held-out rows, the fitted hyperparameters, library versions and the feature list with its sha256; written next to the JSON report (snappy parquet)

corpora.registered_looks_note: The evaluation and robustness seeds may be generated and scored only as the registered run for their role (datagen.corpus_role, scripts/aml_gate.py --registered), and only while this is true. It is set true with the datagen freeze; after a registered look its seed is appended to spent_seeds, which refuses any second look.
corpora.spent_seeds_note: Seeds retired by seed_rule: 42 was looked at by the voided D0 at v3.4.1 (AML-GOALS section 9 #38), 50000042 was the evaluation seed before v3.5.0 moved it. The cluster datagen refuses a spent seed for the financial schema (lakebench/config/datagen_seed.py). Append a seed here when a look at it is voided or burned.
corpora.seed_rule: v3.5.0: a voided or burned look increments the seed by one. D0 at v3.4.1 looked at calibration seed 42 (now 43); the evaluation seed moves with any change after a gate run (50000042 to 50000043). The robustness corpus was never generated and keeps 90000042. Pairwise gaps checked against seed_guard.
corpora.gate_scale_note: AML-GOALS section 9 #36: calibration corpora and D0 run at scale 2 (the local runner refuses another scale unless --diagnostic); D8 still compares scale 10 against the gate scale. entities_per_scale_unit mirrors datagen_rs world.rs (population = round(111111 x scale)) and is how a corpus's scale is read back from its account master.

robustness_perturbation.note: natural units (LN_MU += ln 1.2, not LN_MU * 1.2); values fixed at registration, corpus generated after freeze

level2.if_robustness_fails: publish as 'Level 2 on evaluation corpus, not robust'; do not claim Level 2

band.anchor: verified 2026-09-24 (AML-GOALS section 9 #34): no primary source reports account-level per-typology AP; nearest analogue Tide (arXiv 2603.01863) GBT PR-AUC 0.70-0.85 transaction-level and treats > 0.90 as trivial, supporting the ceiling; TransXion 0.17-0.29 is transaction-level AP without account aggregates and is not a floor; floor self-chosen

leakage.relative_cap_definition: (shortcut_ap - prevalence) <= shortcut_ap_rel_max * (max(ap, band.ap_min) - prevalence); the absolute cap is unchanged and applies as well
leakage.relative_cap_rationale: v3.5.0 (#37/#38): the check asks whether one or two features carry a large share of the signal a typology must have to count. That reference is the band floor unless the model does better. Against the model's own AP alone the cap shrinks to the prevalence as a model weakens, so at prevalence 1e-4 a shortcut a few hundredths above it fails from noise. In band the rule equals lift_over_prevalence; below band the relative cap is at most prevalence + 0.5 x (0.30 - prevalence), about 0.15, under the absolute cap of 0.20, so it is never looser than the absolute cap.

scale_invariance.method: equivalence: bootstrap CI of (scale10 AP - scale1 AP) lies entirely within [-ap_diff_abs_max, +ap_diff_abs_max]

threshold_cliff.definition: density inside [t*(1-w), t) vs [t, t*(1+w)] for every rule threshold t; ratio in either direction must not exceed max_density_ratio

classification.definitional_rule: a typology is definitional only if the generator conditions its label on the single attribute in defining_feature AND that feature alone reaches AP >= definitional_min_single_ap on the calibration corpus
classification.reclassification: behavioural -> definitional is forbidden for this release after any gate run (D0 included); if it happens N stays 4 and the typology counts as a miss. definitional -> behavioural is always allowed.
classification.note: AML-GOALS section 9 #36 (2026-09-24): micro_structuring and corridor_high_risk moved to the behavioural subset; the definitional subset is empty. defining_feature and definitional_min_single_ap are kept for the record and are unused while the subset is empty.

power.below_min: underpowered: counts as a miss against K, never a pass

distribution_match.test: two-sample KS statistic (effect size, not p-value; large n makes p-values meaningless)
applies_to: R2 burst vs account's own amount distribution

timing_mixture.anchor: self-chosen; pending citation (burstiness literature + payments source)

rules.note: reported outcomes owned by P5, not datagen gates

gate_runs.d0_corpus: calibration only; never evaluation or robustness
gate_runs.band_change_after_d0: only via AML-GOALS section 9, and only to figures quoted verbatim from the cited source; otherwise stays [0.30,0.80]

seed_guard.rule: no pairwise seed gap may lie within max_n_inst_scale100 of a multiple of TID_SEED_STRIDE; D10 reads seeds from this file and enumerates iseeds at scale-100 n_inst

features_note: v3.3: customer_type and crr_tier added (AML-GOALS section 9 #32); is_customer excluded because only customers are scored. v3.4: four history-relative features for the monthly unit (unit_of_scoring.history_features). Definitions: src/lakebench/spark/scripts/aml_features.py.
